title: 第28章 进化的门
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
罗影整晚都没有睡觉。

    盘膝坐在床榻之上，将自己的神识沉入至识海之中。

    《万兽衍策》静静悬着。

    页面里，光树是倒着的。

    两道金色的光柱，黯淡着。

    一根巨大的青铜色大柱子，发出很强的光亮。

    罗影望着那两道金光，望了很久。

    【无惧蚁】。【赴难勇蚁】。

    这在世人眼中，是一只【赴死蚁】仅有的两条活路。

    他深吸一口气，心念一动。

    两道金光闪闪的液体，开始流淌。

    一条条地将它们拨离原本的位置，然后全部都注入到那根青铜大柱子里。

    金光一点点地熄灭了。

    青铜色，一分分亮起。

    等到最后一缕余光也没入柱身之后，那两条路就彻底黑了。

    识海中只剩下一道光芒，很亮，仿佛一把出鞘的长剑。

    罗影心里默默地说道：

    '小玄。你当年为了一句话，亲手断了自己的退路。'

    ‘今夜，我陪你。’

    ‘咱们的退路，我也熄了。’

    他屏住呼吸，等待。

    等手背上那道图案发烫，等那一团白光再起。

    但没有。

    书页很静。手背是温暖的，跟往常一样。

    罗影愣了一下之后，慢慢呼出了一口气。

    他知道。

    这本书主要是给图的。

    地图上画出的道路再明亮，也要靠自己踏实地去行走。

    那么，路上还横着什么？

    第二天，罗影继续做他最擅长的事情。

    前世三十年，他蹲过雨林，钻过沙窝，趴在地上数过一整窝的蚂蚁。

    这套功夫搁置了十四年后，重练起来时手上的动作还是非常熟练的。

    他先把金教习的话拆解之后慢慢品味。

    能量充足了，解除心结，随时能进化。

    这话，自然是没错。

    但错误的是，金教习所说的是那两条金灿灿的道路。

    那两条路，都要求有一颗无畏之心。

    小玄要走的，是另一条道路。

    这条路认的心，它生来就有。

    等级，也在【砺勇石】的帮助下提高到了四级。

    心，也够了。

    门立在那儿。

    还要什么？

    罗影并没有去猜。

    猜是外行人做的。

    他从灶屋里面找到一只破陶盆，用河边滩地上的细沙装进去大概半盆，再抹平。

    用沙盘代替纸张，用炭条作笔。

    没有第二只蚂蚁当对照，就让昨日的小玄当了今天的对照。

    一天之内，只做一件事情。

    第一天是去感受一下环境。

    按照初契堂库角的样子，仿照着堆了一堆稻草。

    洒水之后，把泥土围成一块，再拿一把院子里的黄土、一把河滩上的沙子。

    小玄挨个地区都住了一下子。

    奇怪的事情发生了。

    无论在哪里住，它第一件要做的事情都是一样的。

    衔草屑、泥土、谷粒。

    围着自己，垒上小半圈。

    垒到可以藏住自己的时候就不衔了。

    换一个地方，重新开始。

    罗影在沙盘上写下了一行字：处处动口，处处垒坑。坑，不算窝。

    第三天，试食性。

    糙米粒、菜叶梗，再从红糖包中取出几粒糖霜。

    小玄把糖粒衔起来，但是没有吃下去。

    拖到墙缝跟前，埋了。

    舔了舔手指上沾到的浮沫。

    米粒，吃三分，埋七分。

    罗影的炭条顿了一下，然后记下了一行字：三分入口，七分入土。

    贪生怕死的人，先储藏粮食。

    第五天出了问题。

    芦花穿过院子的时候，歪着头，盯上了沙盘旁边的小玄。
content_en:
Luo Ying stayed up all night.

Sitting cross-legged on the bed, he sank his consciousness into the sea of ​​consciousness.

"The Strategy of Ten Thousand Beasts" hangs quietly.

On the page, the light tree is upside down.

Two golden light pillars dimmed.

A huge bronze pillar emits a strong light.

Luo Ying looked at the two golden lights for a long time.

【No fear of ants】.【Brave Ant in Disaster】.

In the eyes of the world, these are the only two ways for a [dead ant] to survive.

He took a deep breath and thought.

Two streams of golden liquid began to flow.

Move them away from their original positions one by one, and then pour them all into the large bronze pillar.

The golden light went out little by little.

Bronze color, lighting up every minute.

After the last ray of light disappeared from the pillar, the two roads were completely dark.

There was only a ray of light left in the sea of ​​consciousness, very bright, like an unsheathed sword.

Luo Ying said silently in his heart:

'Xiao Xuan.Back then, you cut off your retreat with your own hands just for a word.'

‘Tonight, I will accompany you.’

‘I have also blocked our retreat.’

He held his breath and waited.

Wait for the pattern on the back of your hand to become hot, and wait for the white light to appear again.

But no.

The pages are quiet.The back of my hand was warm, as usual.

After Luo Ying was stunned for a moment, he slowly exhaled.

He knows.

This book is mainly for pictures.

No matter how bright the road drawn on the map is, you still have to rely on yourself to walk it steadily.

So, what else is lying on the road?

The next day, Luo Ying continued to do what he did best.

In his previous life, thirty years ago, he squatted in the rainforest, crawled through sand nests, and counted an entire nest of ants while lying on the ground.

After putting this Kung Fu aside for fourteen years, when I started practicing it again, my hand movements were still very skillful.

He first dismantled Jin Jiaoxi's words and then slowly savored them.

When you have enough energy, you can relieve your mental knots and be able to evolve at any time.

This is certainly true.

But the mistake is that what Jin Jiaoxi said was the two golden roads.

Both paths require a fearless heart.

Xiaoxuan wants to take another path.

The heart that recognizes this path is born with it.

The level was also raised to level four with the help of [Hardening Stone].

Heart is enough.

The door stood there.

What else do you want?

Luo Ying did not guess.

Guess it was done by an outsider.

He found a broken pottery basin from the kitchen house, filled about half of it with fine sand from the river beach, and then smoothed it out.

Use a sand tray instead of paper and charcoal sticks as pens.

There is no second ant to serve as a comparison, so yesterday's Xiaoxuan becomes today's control.

In a day, do only one thing.

The first day was to get a feel for the environment.

According to the appearance of the corner of Chuqitang's library, a pile of straw was piled up.

After sprinkling water, gather the soil into a circle, then take a handful of loess from the yard and a handful of sand from the river beach.

Xiaoxuan lived in various areas for a while.

Strange things happened.

No matter where you live, the first thing you do is the same.

Holds grass clippings, soil, and grains.

Make a small half circle around yourself.

When the base is strong enough to hide oneself, it will no longer be held.

Change a place and start over.

Luo Ying wrote a line of words on the sand table: Everywhere you speak, there are pits everywhere.A pit, not a nest.

On the third day, try eating.

Brown rice grains, vegetable leaf stems, and a few grains of icing sugar from the brown sugar bag.

Xiao Xuan picked up the candy but didn't eat it.

Drag it to the crack in the wall and bury it.

Licking the foam on his fingers.

Rice grains, eat three points and bury seven points.

Luo Ying's charcoal note paused for a moment, and then he wrote down a line of words: three points for entrance, seven points for burial.

Those who are greedy for life and afraid of death should first store food.

Something went wrong on the fifth day.

As Luhua walked through the yard, she tilted her head and stared at Xiaoxuan next to the sand table.
